newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL MADRID DRAW UP SHORTLIST OF COACHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL MADRID DRAW UP SHORTLIST OF COACHES.

text.p: The Real Madrid board have drawn up a short-list of three, unnamed foreign coaches to take over from Fabio Capello next season, a club spokesman said on Wednesday.
A decision will be made in the next few days.
The hot favourites for the job are Tenerife's Jupp Heynckes, Dutch national coach Guus Hiddink and Ottmar Hitzfeld who recently took Borussia Dortmund to victory in the European Cup.
Capello has announced he planned to leave Madrid at the end of the season but has not yet disclosed his future plans.
